# H10 | Clicking HUD tile didn't work. Let me try clicking actual game tiles in the rooms.
# Also let me look at the yellow border around orange target.

seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find yellow nodes (border around orange)
y_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y']
print(f"Yellow nodes: {len(y_nodes)}")
for n in y_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Try clicking a light gray tile in the actual game area (not HUD)
# Find tiles in row 9-12 range (top room)
w_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w']
game_tiles = [n for n in w_nodes if min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) >= 5]
print(f"Game light gray tiles: {len(game_tiles)}")

# Click first game tile
if game_tiles:
    target = game_tiles[0]
    b = target['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    center = ((min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2)
    print(f"Clicking tile at {center}")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center[0], 'col': center[1]}])
    print(f"After click: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
    
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    N_nodes = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    w_nodes2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w']
    print(f"Green: {len(N_nodes)}, Light gray: {len(w_nodes2)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
